rules.name: DATE_RANGE
rules.text: Keep only crashes from 2021-01-01 00:00 up to (not including) 2026-05-01 00:00.

rules.name: DUPLICATE_RECORD_ID
rules.text: Drop a row whose CRASH_RECORD_ID already appeared on an earlier row (first occurrence kept).

rules.name: DROP_COLUMNS
rules.text: Remove CRASH_DATE_EST_I, LANE_CNT, CRASH_TYPE, REPORT_TYPE, DATE_POLICE_NOTIFIED, PHOTOS_TAKEN_I, NOT_RIGHT_OF_WAY_I, STATEMENTS_TAKEN_I, IDOT_CONTROL_NO, LOCATION.

rules.name: COORDINATES
rules.text: Drop rows whose coordinates are missing, zero, or outside lat 41.64-42.03 / lon -87.95 to -87.52. Out-of-box points are also listed in out_of_bounds_points.csv.

rules.name: LATE_POLICE_NOTIFICATION
rules.text: Drop rows where DATE_POLICE_NOTIFIED is more than 30 days after CRASH_DATE.

rules.name: YES_NO_INDICATORS
rules.text: Every remaining *_I column becomes YES when the value is Y, otherwise NO (blank -> NO).

rules.name: SPEED_LIMIT
rules.text: Speeds 0-10 become the bucket '0-10'. Drop rows with a speed > 10 that is not a multiple of 5, and rows with a speed > 55.

rules.name: INJURIES_MISSING_TO_ZERO
rules.text: Missing injury counts become 0; counts are written as integers.

rules.name: MISSING_VALUES
rules.text: WORK_ZONE_TYPE blank -> NOT A WORK ZONE (or UNKNOWN when WORK_ZONE_I = Y); blank WORKERS_PRESENT_I / HIT_AND_RUN_I / DOORING_I / INTERSECTION_RELATED_I -> NO; blank BEAT_OF_OCCURRENCE -> UNKNOWN.

rules.name: KSI
rules.text: KSI = INJURIES_FATAL + INJURIES_INCAPACITATING (people killed or seriously injured).

rules.name: NEIGHBORHOOD
rules.text: Name of the boundary polygon from data/igwz-8jzy.geojson (Chicago's 77 community areas) that contains the crash point.

rules.name: ZIPCODE
rules.text: 'zip' of the ZIP-code polygon from data/unjd-c2ca.geojson that contains the crash point.

rules.name: OUTSIDE_CITY_BOUNDARIES
rules.text: Drop rows inside the bounding box but not inside any community-area polygon or any ZIP polygon (e.g. suburbs such as Oak Park, Evanston edge, Cicero), so NEIGHBORHOOD and ZIPCODE are never blank.

rules.name: OTHER_MISSING_VALUES
rules.text: Blank STREET_DIRECTION / STREET_NAME -> UNKNOWN. Blank MOST_SEVERE_INJURY is derived from the injury counts when they exist, otherwise UNKNOWN. Any other blank text cell -> UNKNOWN.

rules.name: FORMAT_AND_ORDER
rules.text: CRASH_DATE written as ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; BEAT written as an integer; output sorted by CRASH_DATE then CRASH_RECORD_ID so two runs give byte-identical files.
